Ukuqala ngokukhawuleza
1. Fakela i-Torque Pro (inguqulo ehlawulwayo; i-Torque Lite ayixhasi iiplugin) kwaye udibanise i-adaptha yakho ye-OBD-II.
2. Vula le plugin ku-Torque → Iisetingi → Iiplugin.
3. Vumela izaziso, kwaye usete ukusetyenziswa kwebhetri ku-Akukho sithintelo ukuze i-Torque iqalise le plugin ngasemva.
4. Ku-Torque, khetha iprofayile yesithuthi semoto oyiqhubayo. Idatha igcinwa ngokweprofayile ye-Torque kwaye ijongwa ngokuchasene nesazisi se-VIN/ECU sesithuthi.
5. Kwiprofayile entsha umthombo wamafutha ufunyanwa xa udibanisa; ukuba ucelwa, uthelekise negeyiji yedashibhodi uze ucofe Qinisekisa. U-Qinisekisa ukwiphepha lokuseta nakwisaziso. Ungakhetha nangaphantsi.
6. Ubungakanani betanki bubungakanani bokuqala bokulungelelanisa kwe-Chunk de ifunde obayo. Iplugin ayikhe ibuguqule; ubungakanani obufundiweyo bokulungelelanisa ngakunye buboniswa ngaphantsi kwabo.
7. Ku-Torque, yongeza iigeyiji ze-[FuelSmooth] Smoothed Fuel Level kunye, kokulungelelanisa ngakunye, Corrected %, Remaining, DTE kunye Tank size. I-DTE yi-Remaining iphindaphindwe nge-mpg yexesha elide ye-Torque. Isaziso ngexesha lokulungelelanisa kwakhona sithetha ukuba oko kulungelelanisa kufunda i-1:1 de kugqitywe ukulungelelanisa kwakhona.
8. Buyisela inqanaba lamafutha ku-Torque: Cima, Guda, okanye Lungisiwe ukusuka ekulungelelaniseni kwe-Chunk, Band okanye Kalman kwiigeyiji yakho ye-012F.
9. Amafutha abalwa kuphela ngelixa injini isebenza. Iplugin isebenza kuphela ngelixa i-Torque idityaniswe ne-ECU.
10. Qhubeka uqhuba uze ugcwalise; ukuchaneka kukhula kwiitanki ezingaphelelanga ezininzi. Ukuba isaziso seProfayile yesithuthi engalunganga? sibonakala, khetha ukuba wenze ntoni ngolo hambo.
11. Yonke idatha ihlala kule fowuni. Akukho GPS okanye indawo irekhodwayo.

Buyisela inqanaba lamafutha ku-Torque (ibhala phezu kwe-012F)
Ukuqalisa ngebhetri okanye ngasemva kwaliwe. Vula kanye ukuze iplugin isebenze ne-Torque.

Yongeza iitanki ezongezelelweyo xa kufuneka (itanki yefektri 1 ihlala). Ungazifaki izivamvo kwipini ye-PCM FLI (ukuzalisa okungeyonyani). Itanki nganye eyongezelelweyo ifuna eyayo i-PID eyongezelelweyo ye-Torque (MCU Mode 22, igama elahlukileyo — hayi 012F okanye Ford 16C1). Ixabiso le-Select-PID yi-id yetanki eqala ku-1. I-Gal/hr ibhalwa kwitanki esebenzayo kuphela.
Ubungakanani betanki bubungakanani bokuqala bokulungelelanisa kwe-Chunk de ifunde obayo. Iplugin ayikhe ibuguqule; ubungakanani obufundiweyo bokulungelelanisa ngakunye buboniswa ngaphantsi kwabo.

Ibhala ixabiso kwi-Fuel Level eqhelekileyo ye-Torque (012F) ukuze iigeyiji ezikhoyo zilibonise: Cima, Guda, okanye Lungisiwe ukusuka ekulungelelaniseni kwe-Chunk, Band okanye Kalman. Ukulungelelanisa okungakhiwa kubhala inqanaba eligudisiweyo.
Ifuna i-Torque Pro (ehlawulwayo). I-Torque Lite ayixhasi iiplugin.
Ukungena okuneenkcukacha (debug; imigca yokungena ngomzuzwana ngamnye)
Igama lale profayile yesithuthi. Iprofayile nganye yesithuthi ye-Torque ifumana iprofayile yayo yeplugin, idatha yayo kunye neemephu ezifundiweyo.
Uphawu lwesithuthi (umz. Ford). Lisetyenziswa kuphela ukukhetha ukuba zeziphi i-PID zamafutha zoluphawu ukufumanisa okunokuzizama.

Apho inqanaba lamafutha elingaqinisekanga livela khona. Fumanisa (i-ECU kufuneka idityanisiwe) izama abaviwa ngokufunda kuphela kwaye ikucela ukuba uqinisekise ngaphandle kokuba imithombo emibini ivumelana. U-Qinisekisa ukwiphepha lokuseta nakwisaziso. Akukho = fumanisa kuxhumano olulandelayo.
Kuphela kumthombo «i-PID eyongezelelweyo ye-Torque ngokwegama elide»: igama elide elichanekileyo le-PID ye-Torque exela inqanaba.
ngenanto = akukho bungakanani bokuqala; ukulungelelanisa ngakunye kufunda okwabo.
Ixesha eliqinisekileyo lesihluzi sokugudisa (0 = akukho kugudisa).
Utshintsho olukhulu ngomzuzwana olunokulandelwa linqanaba eligudisiweyo; ukugubha ngaphaya kwaloo nto akuhoywa.
Ukunyuka kwenqanaba ngelixa umile okubalwa njengokuzalisa.
Ngokuzikhethela: faka ukufundwa kwe-odometer uze u-Gcina ipini ukuze ubophe umgama wale profayile.
Ukuba yeyiphi itanki ekufakwa kuyo ukutshisa amafutha (gal/hr). Ivela kwi-PID: i-PID ye-Torque iyikhetha (i-id yetanki eqala ku-1).
Kuphela xa Itanki esebenzayo = Ivela kwi-PID: igama elide le-PID ye-Torque enexabiso le-id yetanki.
Igama elide elizenzekelayo letanki %1$d (umz. [FuelSmooth] Tank%1$d Level)
I-Fuel Smoothing ilungelelanisa kwakhona imephu ye-%1$s. Oko kulungelelanisa kufunda i-1:1 de kugqitywe ukulungelelanisa kwakhona.
I-Fuel Smoothing ayinamthombo wenqanaba lamafutha we-%1$s. Vula iphepha lokuseta uze ucofe u-Fumanisa, okanye ukhethe umthombo.
I-%1$s ayikhange inike inqanaba elisebenzisekayo le-%2$s. Jonga uqhagamshelo lwe-adaptha, okanye usebenzise u-Fumanisa kwiphepha lokuseta.
Vula useto lwe-Fuel Smoothing uze ukhethe umthombo (okanye wongeze i-PID ku-Torque), emva koko ucofe u-Fumanisa.
Kufunyenwe i-%1$s efunda i-%2$.0f %% ye-%3$s. Jonga ukuba ihambelana negeyiji yamafutha yedashibhodi, emva koko ucofe u-Qinisekisa. U-Qinisekisa ukwiphepha lokuseta nakwisaziso (%4$s).
Kufunyenwe i-%1$s ye-%2$s. Jonga ukuba ihambelana negeyiji yamafutha yedashibhodi, emva koko ucofe u-Qinisekisa. U-Qinisekisa ukwiphepha lokuseta nakwisaziso (%3$s).
Esi sithuthi yi-%1$s (%2$s), kodwa iprofayile ye-Torque yi-\'%3$s\'. Idatha iya ku-%1$s; cofa ukuvula i-Torque utshintshe iprofayile.
Iprofayile ye-Torque \'%1$s\' ayihambelani nesi sithuthi (%2$s). Isiphakamiso: %3$s. Idatha ibanjwa kwaye ilahlwa ekupheleni kohambo ngaphandle kokuba uyigcina.
Olu hambo luya kugcinwa ku-%1$s. I-API yeplugin ye-Torque ayikwazi ukudala okanye ukutshintsha iiprofayile ze-Torque: ku-Torque, yenza okanye ukhethe iprofayile yesithuthi ebizwa ngokuba yi-\'%2$s\'.
